title: Total Pulses Sent
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the traveler sends out 2t_1 pulses during the entire trip.

title: Outgoing Pulses Received
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the number of pulses received by the traveler during the outgoing trip as t_1 * sqrt((1 - beta)/(1 + beta)).

title: Ingoing Pulses Received
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the number of pulses received by the traveler during the ingoing trip as t_1 * sqrt((1 + beta)/(1 - beta)).

title: Ratio of Pulses
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the ratio of total pulses received to those sent by the traveler as 1/sqrt(1 - beta^2).

title: Home Twin Pulses
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the number of pulses received by the stay-at-home twin during the intervals t_2 and t_3.

title: Frequency Ratios
description: Important Criteria: The student must determine the ratio of lowered-frequency pulses to raised-frequency pulses received by the home twin as 1.

title: Total Pulses Ratio
description: Important Criteria: The student must find the ratio of total pulses sent by the home twin to those received as 1/sqrt(1 - beta^2).

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the calculations for frequency shifts and pulse counts.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all time intervals and frequencies are expressed in consistent units.
